# Vasool

> Vasool is a voice-entry loan collection and lending platform for money lenders, finance companies and NBFCs in India. It records daily, weekly and monthly collections by voice in 6 languages, runs EMI, gold, interest-only (kandhu vatti) and product-backed loans plus chit funds and savings schemes, scores credit risk with AI, tracks field staff with live GPS, and works fully offline.

Vasool (also known as Vasool Drive) is built by Thukal for the Indian lending market: daily finance, weekly finance, monthly finance, kandhu vatti, thandal, byaj wasooli and ugrani style collections. The website is available in English and Tamil (/ta pages).

## Solutions

- [Loan Collection App](https://vasool.app/loan-collection-app): Loan collection for money lenders
- [Daily Collection App](https://vasool.app/daily-collection-app): Daily finance collection
- [Voice Entry Collection App](https://vasool.app/voice-entry-collection-app): Record collections by speaking (India focus — six Indian languages plus English)
- [Voice Approval Workflow](https://vasool.app/voice-approval-workflow): The full field round across all supported countries — officers dictate collections AND expenses in local languages, every entry is tagged to a GPS-tracked route, gated resources are held for an approver, and the day closes on a per-route day book, officer performance, DPD ageing and P&L. Approvals are NOT given by voice, and individual collection entries cannot be gated yet
- [Weekly Collection App](https://vasool.app/weekly-collection-app): Weekly finance collection
- [Monthly Finance App](https://vasool.app/monthly-finance-app): Monthly finance and EMI collection
- [Line Management App](https://vasool.app/line-management-app): Line-wise collection management
- [Kandhu Vatti App](https://vasool.app/kandhu-vatti-app): Kandhu vatti lending management
- [Byaj Wasooli App](https://vasool.app/byaj-wasooli-app): Byaj wasooli interest collection
- [Ugrani App](https://vasool.app/ugrani-app): Ugrani collection management
- [Self-Hosted Loan Software](https://vasool.app/self-hosted-loan-software): Run Vasool on your own infrastructure
- [White-Label Loan App](https://vasool.app/white-label-loan-app): Vasool under your own brand
- [Chit Fund & Lending App](https://vasool.app/chit-fund-and-lending-app): Chit fund and lending management
- [NBFC Loan Management](https://vasool.app/nbfc-loan-management): Loan management software for NBFCs in India
- [SACCO Management System](https://vasool.app/sacco-management-system): Loans and collections for SACCOs — guarantor tracking, M-Pesa references, arrears ageing (not a full SACCO system; shares and deposits stay in your core system)
- [Aplikasi Koperasi Simpan Pinjam](https://vasool.app/aplikasi-koperasi-simpan-pinjam): Indonesian-language page for koperasi loan and field collection management
- [Software de Cobranza](https://vasool.app/software-de-cobranza): Spanish-language page for formal microcredit field collections in Colombia
- [Debt Collection Software South Africa](https://vasool.app/debt-collection-software-south-africa): Arrears ageing, promise-to-pay tracking and payment allocation for South African credit providers

## Countries

Vasool supports company setup in eight countries. Each sets its own currency, local business date and time zone without changing the accounting meaning of any recorded amount. Voice entry works in every supported market, in the languages officers speak on those routes — it is not India-only. Maker-checker approvals are available everywhere too. Vasool is collections and portfolio software — it is not a lending licence, registration or regulatory approval in any market.

- [Supported Countries](https://vasool.app/countries): All eight markets, with the buyer, payment rail, currency and regulatory home for each
- [Philippines](https://vasool.app/loan-management-software-philippines): SEC-registered lending companies and cooperatives — PHP, GCash/Maya tagging, daily and weekly field collection
- [Nigeria](https://vasool.app/loan-management-software-nigeria): Microfinance banks, cooperatives and market lenders — NGN, group and individual exposure, portfolio at risk
- [Kenya](https://vasool.app/loan-management-software-kenya): SACCOs and digital credit providers — KES, M-Pesa channel and transaction reference on every payment
- [Sri Lanka](https://vasool.app/loan-management-software-sri-lanka): Licensed microfinance and finance companies — LKR, Tamil and English interface
- [Indonesia](https://vasool.app/loan-management-software-indonesia): Koperasi simpan pinjam, BPR and microfinance institutions — IDR amounts stored exactly as entered
- [Cambodia](https://vasool.app/loan-management-software-cambodia): Market page only — Cambodia is NOT selectable at company setup, and dual-currency KHR/USD support and Khmer (interface and voice dictation) are not shipped
- [South Africa](https://vasool.app/loan-management-software-south-africa): NCR-registered credit providers — ZAR, agreement and affordability-evidence records, payment allocation
- [Colombia](https://vasool.app/loan-management-software-colombia): Supervised microcredit institutions and cooperatives — COP, per-modality pricing; not for informal gota a gota lending
- [India](https://vasool.app/nbfc-loan-management): Money lenders, finance companies and NBFCs — INR, voice entry, kandhu vatti and EMI books

## Blog

Practical, field-tested articles for money lenders, finance companies and
NBFCs — collections, field operations, compliance and product/engineering
notes. This list is generated from `src/content/blog/*.md` on every build.

<!-- llms:blog:start -->
- [Blog](https://vasool.app/blog): Articles on loan collection, field operations, compliance and product updates for money lenders and NBFCs
- [Agent Chit: How to Run a Chit Group Without a Register](https://vasool.app/blog/agent-chit-fund-management-app): What an agent chit is, why it breaks past twenty members, and how one app reminds every member, holds their location, and tracks cycles and commission.
- [Your Lending Business Shouldn’t Live in One Person’s Memory](https://vasool.app/blog/your-lending-business-shouldnt-live-in-memory): Real stories of how paper-based lending nearly destroyed families — and what every money lender can do before it happens to them.
- [Try Vasool for 45 Days: ₹700, Fully Refundable](https://vasool.app/blog/45-day-risk-free-trial-for-money-lenders): Run your real collection book on Vasool for 45 days for ₹700 — refundable any time. Plus the full cost breakdown of what serving you actually costs us.
- [Why Vasool's AI Credit-Risk Score Is Advisory, Not Automatic](https://vasool.app/blog/why-ai-credit-risk-scoring-is-advisory-not-automatic): How Vasool's AI credit-risk scoring works — what it reads from KYC, repayment history, and GPS visit data — and why the decision still belongs to a human.
- [The NBFC Compliance Checklist: What Loan Software Should (and Shouldn't) Promise](https://vasool.app/blog/nbfc-compliance-checklist-what-loan-software-should-promise): The governance controls a regulated NBFC should demand from loan software — audit trails, maker-checker, data isolation, KYC — and what no vendor should claim yet.
- [How We Replay Offline Collections Through Our Own API](https://vasool.app/blog/how-we-replay-offline-collections-through-our-own-api): Building offline-first field collections without a second, weaker write path — HTTP replay through the live router, idempotency keys, tombstones, and kill switches.
- [Multi-Tenancy: Why Every Tenant Gets Its Own Database](https://vasool.app/blog/multi-tenant-architecture-one-database-per-tenant): How Vasool isolates each finance company in its own container and PostgreSQL database — why we rejected shared tables with a tenant_id, and what that choice costs us.
- [Why We Built Vasool's Backend in Go, Not Node.js](https://vasool.app/blog/why-we-built-our-backend-in-go-not-node): The engineering case for Go over TypeScript on the server — deployment artefacts, per-tenant memory, money maths, and the places Go still hurts.
- [Why Choose the Vasool App Over Other Loan Collection Apps](https://vasool.app/blog/why-choose-vasool-over-other-loan-collection-apps): A practical comparison for money lenders and NBFCs — why Vasool's voice entry, offline-first design, and data ownership beat generic loan collection apps.
- [How to Reduce Loan Defaults with Daily Field Collections](https://vasool.app/blog/reduce-loan-defaults-with-daily-field-collections): Practical, field-tested ways money lenders and NBFCs cut defaults — tighter daily follow-ups, real-time visibility, and proof of every visit.
- [Voice Entry vs Manual Entry: Faster Collections for Field Agents](https://vasool.app/blog/voice-entry-vs-manual-entry-field-collections): Why speaking a collection is faster and more accurate than typing it — and what that means for daily finance companies running large field teams.
- [Choosing Loan Collection Software: A Checklist for NBFCs & Money Lenders](https://vasool.app/blog/choosing-loan-collection-software-checklist): A no-nonsense checklist for evaluating loan collection and lending software — data ownership, offline support, staff tracking, and the questions vendors hope you won't ask.
